title: Select valid image updates preview
description: Verify that selecting a valid image updates the preview and stores the selection.
preconditions: User is on the page containing the image selector component.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the page with the image selector."
2. "Click the Select Image button to open the file picker."
3. "Choose a valid image file (e.g., sample.png) and confirm."
4. "Observe the UI after selection."
steps_result:
1. "File picker opens and displays image files."
2. "User selects a valid image (e.g., PNG)."
3. "Selected image thumbnail appears in the preview area."
4. "Image file path/value is stored in the component state."

title: Selecting non‑image file shows error
description: Ensure that selecting a non‑image file triggers an appropriate error message.
preconditions: User is on the page containing the image selector component.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the page with the image selector."
2. "Click the Select Image button to open the file picker."
3. "Choose a non‑image file (e.g., notes.txt) and confirm."
4. "Observe the UI after selection."
steps_result:
1. "File picker opens and displays all files."
2. "User selects a non‑image file (e.g., document.txt)."
3. "Error message Invalid file type. Please select an image. is displayed."
4. "No image preview is shown and component state remains unchanged."

title: Corrupted image file handled gracefully
description: Validate that selecting a corrupted image file does not crash the application and shows a fallback error.
preconditions: User is on the page containing the image selector component.
steps_actions:
1. "Open the page with the image selector."
2. "Click the Select Image button to open the file picker."
3. "Choose a corrupted image file (e.g., corrupted.jpg) and confirm."
4. "Observe the UI and application stability after selection."
steps_result:
1. "File picker opens and displays image files."
2. "User selects a corrupted image file."
3. "Error message Unable to load image. Please choose another file. is displayed."
4. "Application remains responsive and no crash occurs."
